rachats.nom: Australasian Medical & Scientific Limited (AMSL) et New Zealand Medical & Scientific (NZMS)
rachats.citation: As of the 1st August 2021, Richard has sold all his shares in both companies to Dexcom, Inc., a leader in the medical technology industry and as such, Dexcom, Inc. has now acquired AMSL and NZMS.
Dexcom has bought Nutrisense , a company that makes a wellness app that uses data from continuous glucose monitors.
